purpose: Execute agreed candidate plan: synchronization-conditioned static translation retention on exact R2, no gain search or weakened actuator protection
hypothesis: Unconditional retention of a useful translation estimate may maintain compensation while observed synchronization state worsens. Retain the original translation weights only when filtered angular-error growth is not clearly positive and the admitted NN synchronization increment is non-adverse to sigmaAlpha; otherwise use original gradient plus leakage.
predicate: OriginalR2 retention eligibility AND qAlpha*vAlpha<=abs(qAlpha)*vResolution AND sigmaAlpha*(deltaL+deltaR)>=0. vResolution is1RPM times configured meter/s/RPM divided by0.6m, representing sum of two half-RPM quantization steps. It is an engineering deadband, NOT a proven noise bound or task accuracy tolerance.

theoryBoundary: Instantaneous admitted-NN non-adverse sigma work plus filtered growth indicator only; does not prove total angular-energy decrease or closed-loop stability. Both output and leakage affect subsequent plant trajectory.
